prerequisites: None. Competencies conveyed in the basic modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students have advanced basic knowledge and skills in a selected sub-area of computer science.
Students know practical concepts and applications in the selected sub-area of computer science.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods to independently solve problems and communicate the solution.
Students have acquired competencies preferably from the field of Theoretical Computer Science.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Written exam or oral exam (individual exam)

assessment_rules: Grading is based on a point scale of 0 to 15 points, according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science program. Students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments to be eligible for the final exam.
